newsitem.title: ITALY: Salomon confirms buy on Telecom Italia.
newsitem.headline: Salomon confirms buy on Telecom Italia.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it had an underweight stance on European telecoms operators but confirmed its buy recommendation on Italy's Telecom Italia and Greece's OTE.

Salomon said in a market note it believed that the risks facing the national operators "outweigh the not insignificant benefits that could come from substantially higher usage of telecommunications networks in the future."
However, there were some good investment opportunities.

"Telecom Italia and OTE remain our only current Buy recommendations among the national operators in Europe. The former is just plain cheap on cash flow valuation and the latter is by far the strongest cash flow growth story in Europe," Salomon said.
The report forecast Telecom Italia 1997 net income of 2.453 billion lire and profit per share of 299 lire and 1988 net income of 2.806 trillion lire with profit per share of 342 lire.

"We believe that investors will enjoy another couple of strong years from Telecom Italia. Although weak internationally, the outlook for it remains positive and we continue to recommend the shares." Salomon said.
Telecom Italia opened on the Milan bourse on Tuesday 0.97 percent up at 4,150 lire.
